# Adaptive Workout Coach

Adaptive Workout Coach is a lightweight guided workout app: pure HTML, CSS,
and JavaScript, no build step, no server, no accounts. It runs as a static
site (GitHub Pages serves the docs/ folder). Open the URL and follow the
30-minute session, three times per week — even with no routine, no plan, and
no experience. Every exercise tells the user exactly what to do, in what
order, with big legible dose labels (sets x reps), muscle-group tags, and
demo video links where verified demos exist. No expertise required.

## The program

A PT-approved 3-phase program, about 3 weeks per phase, 3 sessions per week.
Phase 1 "Reactivate" (8 exercises): quad activation, range of motion,
balance, no loaded knee bending. Phase 2 "Reload" (11 exercises): light
loaded patterns, bilateral before unilateral. Phase 3 "Return" (12
exercises): the full routine including Bulgarian split squats. A phase picker
selects the current phase; progression tracks sessions toward 9 per phase;
phase-ups require confirming an advancement checklist (no swelling after
sessions, pain 2/10 or less during with zero pain the next morning, every set
with good control).

## What the app does

- Runs a guided 30-minute workout with a single stored timer deadline, so
  closing and reopening the browser resumes with the correct time left.
- Full session lifecycle: start, pause, resume, clear (with confirmation),
  complete, timer expiry.
- Per-exercise checklists, accordion sections, progress bar, sticky status
  bar, big dose labels.
- Tue-Sat gym calendar (Sundays are for church, Mondays are rest) with a
  configurable third gym day; completed days log toward the 3-per-week goal.
- Demo videos come from a topic-organized video library
  (docs/video-library.js). To swap an exercise's videos, edit only that file.
  Demo URLs are only added when verified, never invented.
- All progress is stored in the browser's localStorage. No accounts, no
  analytics, no tracking, no personal data.

## Project layout

- docs/index.html -- app shell (status bar, timer, routine, calendar,
  phase picker, checklist).
- docs/styles.css -- styles, native CSS, light/dark aware.
- docs/app.js -- all app logic: phases, timer, calendar, checklist,
  progression. Progress persists in localStorage.
- docs/video-library.js -- topic-organized demo video library. This is the
  file to edit when swapping videos.
- README.md -- full documentation.
- llms.txt -- this file.

## How to run it

Live: https://jhanisusM.github.io/adaptive-workout-coach/ (GitHub Pages,
deploys from docs/ on every push to main).

Locally: serve the docs/ folder with any static file server, e.g.
`cd docs && python3 -m http.server 8000`, then open http://localhost:8000.

## Safety

This is a workout companion, not medical advice. The app tells users to train
within a comfortable range, that sharp pain is a stop sign, and to follow
their clinician's guidance when training around an injury or condition.
